## Triage: first touch → `domain:server` · `lease:A2` · p2 · 2026-11-15T22:39Z

⛔ Not a claim. Requested by repo:cloud#3 (mailbox comment 6902551550).

The audit sealer chains only by a `tenant_id` column, so an object whose organization lives in another column cannot be sealed. That blocks cloud#4128 item 4: Enterprise's `sys_ai_audit_log` opting into tamper evidence, as ADR-0154 D10 promises. A financial customer's reviewer asks for the same proof on the AI tool-call trail as on the main audit log. A cross-repo seam on a stated customer requirement, so **p2** stands. It is the same plugin-audit family as #31908 (A2). Card cloud#4128 waits on it, so `pm:blocking` is added for H14.

domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jVPGBoi3MCGoKbW1Hv

Claim: server area S1 (A1+A2) under #33751 §2 area-lease mode, area A2, seat `domain:server#5` · p2, `pm:blocking` (blocks objectstack-ai/cloud#4128 item 4). The slot was freed while #33918 waits on a maintainer decision. Executed by an `os-dev` subagent of the area S1 thread · posted at 2026-11-16T03:33Z
Session: `session_01QsR2jVPGBoi3MCGoKbW1Hv`
Account: `zhuangjianguo`
Branch: `claude/area-A2-34164`
Worktree: `objectstack-area-A2-34164`
Domain: `domain:server`
Seat: `domain:server#5`
File surface:
- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: the new optional key `lifecycle.seal.chainField`, its describe text, and its authoring refusal. The generated baselines and docs it regenerates come with it.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-seal/**`: one shared reader of a row's chain value, used by the sealer, the verifier and the proof bundle. It replaces each `tenantOf`. The sealer-time "no tenant_id" refusal goes.
- The `os audit verify` command, only where it reads the chain.
- One card-named test file per package.
- Changesets.
- One note in `docs/adr/0154-*.md` (see the ADR line below).
On any breach, stop and explain in the report.
Container & model: `S-M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (no path-derived mandate)`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening). A sealed object may name its chain column, the default stays `tenant_id`, and an object that seals today is byte-identical. The dev measures this again before the PR.
Metadata-protocol: added
Seat ruling (S1 thread):
- `chainField` is optional, defaults to `tenant_id`, and must name a field the object has. Fields the registry injects count, including the ADR-0131 `organization_id`.
- Publish refuses an unknown name. That refusal replaces today's sealer-time error.
- The sealer, the verifier and the bundle read the value through one function.
- The signed body keeps its `tenant_id` member, carrying the chain column's value.
ADR-0154: a note rides this PR.
- D4 already defines the checkpoint's chain as the organization id, not as a column, so the signed body's member needs no change.
- D10 names the key's shape as `lifecycle.seal = { valueFields }`, and D5 says a row seals into the chain of the organization "its `tenant_id` names". Both read as the column, so one note records `chainField` and that reading.
- A `docs/adr/**` path makes the PR Tier H, and the seat runs the hand-off.
Responsibility: `the audit sealer chains only by a tenant_id column, so an object whose organization lives in organization_id cannot be sealed (objectstack) | objectstack-ai/cloud#4128 | Enterprise customers whose AI audit trail must carry the same proof as the main audit log`
Thread-read: none
Premise: holds as filed. `sealer.ts` `plans()` refuses an object with no `tenant_id`, and the chain is read from `tenant_id` only, in the sealer, the verifier and the signed body. The dev measures this again on main.
Pre-claim lane: server, because the reader is in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/**`. The spec key is the ADR-0049 pair with its reader, and it stays here under the 2026-11-15T13:56Z cross-lane rule with CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review. No cloud code is involved.
Pre-claim deps: open PR #33675 (another seat's) touches `audit-seal/sealer.ts`, `index.ts` and the seal test kit. Merge-tree runs against it and against #34220 and origin/main before the push. On a conflict the area tells the seat before pushing.
Prior rulings read: the seat's shape ruling on the S1 thread; ADR-0154 D4, D5 and D10; ADR-0131 (the injected `organization_id`); ADR-0049 (the key lands with its reader).
Serial constraints cleared: #34168 / #33790 / #34257 (this area, other files)
